_about: Tools and datasets shown on the Tools page. 'type' decides the section: "tool" or "data". Items with "featured": true also appear on the home page. To add one, copy a block and change the values. 'icon' is an id from assets/img/icons.svg without the 'i-'. Each link needs a label, an href (web address), and an icon. Leave "links": [] empty if nothing is public yet. Later, a tool can get its own page in tools/<name>/index.html; put that path in "page".

tools.name: Big Five Adaptive Inventory
tools.summary: A computerized adaptive Big Five test based on item response theory. Each next item is chosen from the current trait estimate, so a few items per trait give precise scores.
tools.todo: Links to the R and Qualtrics versions

tools.name: Dynamic Contingency Model
tools.summary: A Bayesian dynamic structural equation model of how behavior and situations relate in the same moment and over time, adjusted for unequal time between surveys.

tools.name: DILT model
tools.summary: The Dynamic Individualized Latent Trait model: a shared trait structure plus each person's own item structure and dynamics over time and context.
tools.todo: Link to the code, when public

tools.name: Cognitive Variability Battery
tools.summary: Nine smartphone tests of attentional control, processing speed, and episodic memory, designed to be taken repeatedly in daily life.

tools.name: VISTA
tools.summary: Variability in Individuals across Situations, Traits, and Adaptations: experience sampling data on personality states and situations from undergraduates.
